limits: One policy, seed42, one environment per native command and fresh Gazebo world per command. Noiseless/material ablations are evaluations, not retraining. Reset-heavy 1ms trial is invalid for gait comparison. Target jumps are not actual joint displacements; force and velocity sampling differ. Weak autocorrelation is not a reliable gait period. Gazebo contact CSVs used here contain robot-side link-frame wrenches, rotated using FK; static-ground wrench attempt was discarded.
